StillOnline — uptime monitoring and status pages for indie SaaS

# Uptime monitoring and hosted status pages for indie SaaS and AI agents — in 60 seconds

Monitor health URLs, publish public/private status pages, manage incidents, alert owners via Telegram/Slack/email, and let AI agents read status via REST API or MCP.

StillOnline is hosted uptime monitoring and status pages for indie SaaS: HTTP URL checks, incidents, and owner alerts. Plans are $0 / $9 / $29—Free includes 1 URL on a 5-minute interval with no self-hosting.

Quick answer

StillOnline schedules HTTP checks on your URLs, publishes live status at /s/{slug}, and alerts owners via Telegram, Slack, or email. Free covers 1 project and 1 URL; Pro ($9/mo) adds private pages, REST API, and MCP for AI agents.

- No heavy observability stack.
- No self-hosting.
- No extra complexity.

## For teams that need simple product status control

StillOnline is built for solo founders, indie developers, and small SaaS teams with one or more critical products, pages, APIs, or services.

You do not need a heavy observability stack, self-hosting, or a patchwork of tools. StillOnline gives you a clear way to track uptime, see incidents, and understand what is happening.

### Solo founders

Monitor your first product without complex setup.

### Micro-SaaS teams

Track site, API, dashboard, and billing pages.

### Teams with AI agents

Give agents a clear status source via API/MCP.

## Listed on SaaS directories and MCP catalogs

Find StillOnline where teams discover uptime monitoring tools

## Manual checks stop working as products multiply

With one project you can check everything by hand. Once you add a site, API, admin panel, billing page, customer portal, and multiple environments, keeping status in your head gets hard.

- The team learns about issues too late.
- Incidents get lost in chat.
- Customers report problems before the team reacts.
- AI agents lack a single source of truth for product state.

StillOnline brings checks, status, incidents, notifications, and API/MCP together in one lightweight service.

Customer message

"Cannot pay — checkout returns 500 for 2 hours"

Team chat

"Does anyone know why the API timed out for the agent?"

## One product → clear status → fast action

Create a project, add URLs to monitor — StillOnline starts tracking product health.

See what works, what is down, what is degraded, and which incidents are active. When something breaks, the owner gets notified.

Share a public status page with customers, partners, or AI agents. On paid plans you can keep it private.

In 60 seconds your product has one place that shows its current state.

## Uptime alerts without manual checks — more clarity

StillOnline helps your team see product state without extra calls, manual pings, or “is everything up?” messages. Every product has clear status, check history, active incidents, and API for automation.

StillOnline does not replace logs, tracing, infra charts, complex alerting, or on-call rotations. It solves a practical job for small teams:

know if the product works, where the issue is, and what users see right now.

## Everything you need to track product status

### URL checks

Monitor site, API, dashboard, billing, or any critical endpoint.

### Automatic status page

Every project gets its own status page when created.

### Public or private access

Open the page to everyone or make it private on paid plans.

### Incident management

Record outages, degradation, and recovery.

### Owner notifications

Get notified when the product becomes unavailable.

### Google subscription

Users can subscribe to status page updates via Google Sign-In.

### REST API and MCP

Connect external tools, automations, and AI agents.

### Check history

Review past URL checks; on paid plans — longer retention and flexible monitoring intervals.

## When StillOnline is especially useful

### Track multiple SaaS products

Keep all project status in one place.

### Monitor APIs

Check health URLs and show status to users or agents.

### Transparent incidents

Do not lose context in chat — record events on the status page.

### Truth source for AI agents

Agents read public status or manage projects via private API/MCP.

### Reduce manual checks

The team sees product state without constant manual monitoring.

HTTP for status, projects, and incidents

## REST API

- Public endpoint — read open status pages without a key.
- Private API v1 on Pro/Ultimate: projects, checks, incidents.
- OpenAPI spec and Bearer keys in the dashboard.

REST API docs Feature page

# Public API

GET api.stillonline.tech/v1/public/status/{slug}

# Sample response

```
{
  "project": "Acme API",
  "status": "operational",
  "active_incidents": [],
  "last_updated": "2024-03-10T14:22:00Z"
}
```

# Install / verify

```
npx -y stillonline-mcp
```

Package on npmjs.com (stillonline-mcp) ↗

Cursor, Claude Desktop, and other MCP clients

## MCP for AI editors

- stillonline-mcp on npm — agent tools for projects, checks, and incidents.
- One command: npx downloads the package when MCP starts.
- API key belongs in editor config, not in the chat.

## Why not just a full observability stack?

Large observability platforms shine when you have complex infrastructure, many services, logs, tracing, charts, on-call, and a dedicated platform team.

Small SaaS teams often need something simpler: quickly know if the product works, show status, and not miss incidents. StillOnline focuses on exactly that.

## Start free, scale as you grow

Pick a plan by projects, monitored URLs, and automation needs.

### Free

For your first product and basic status control.

- 1 project
- 1 monitored URL
- Checks every 5 minutes
- 24-hour check history
- 1 public status page
- Up to 50 email subscribers per page
- Owner notifications

### Pro

For SaaS teams that need faster detection and incidents.

$9/mo

- Up to 10 projects
- Up to 10 URLs per project
- Checks every 5 / 3 / 2 min
- 90-day history
- Public and private pages
- REST API and MCP
- Incident API
- Up to 100 email subscribers per page
- Page Speed: up to 3 URLs per project (mobile + desktop)

### Ultimate

For teams with many products and URLs.

$29/mo

- Up to 100 projects
- Up to 25 URLs per project
- Checks every 1–5 min
- 90-day history
- Private pages
- REST API and MCP
- Priority notifications
- Up to 500 email subscribers per page
- Page Speed: up to 5 URLs per project (mobile + desktop)
